summary: Mr. Mosseri shares a list of top songs of the Shabbat that have withstood the test of time and give shape to the Shabbat. He reviews about 15 songs in page order, providing page numbers and the first few words of each. He notes that most of these are general songs not related to any particular occasion, which everyone can sing together without needing a hazan or solo parts.
